title: 재주 고르기
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: gameplay concept screenshot for a 2D pixel-art game planning article; opaque landscape 16:9, 1536x864.
Primary request: Show the reward screen of a bright, cheerful turn-based roguelike set in a Korean folklore village. The player has just won a friendly match against the village leader, a dokkaebi, and now picks one of three skills to learn from friendly yokai.
Scene/backdrop: upper 40 percent of the screen is a village street in warm late-afternoon light: hanok houses with gently curved grey tiled roofs, white plaster walls and wooden posts, a low stone wall, soft green hills, a peach-and-cream sky.
Subject: on the upper left stands a friendly, chubby, blue-skinned dokkaebi (Korean goblin) with one small yellow horn, a spiky dark hair tuft, a huge happy grin with two tiny fangs, rosy cheeks, a green vest and baggy brown hanbok trousers. He rests a studded wooden club on one shoulder and waves cheerfully with the other hand, a good loser after a playful contest. An empty white rounded speech bubble points from him to the right.
Composition/framing: lower 55 percent is a warm cream panel holding exactly three upright skill cards of equal size, side by side, evenly spaced. The middle card is lifted slightly and has a thick golden selection border. Each card has a colored top band (left card red, middle card blue, right card green) and a square portrait frame in its upper left corner: left card shows a pair of small guardian dogs, one red-brown with black patches and one black; middle card shows a blue horse with a flowing white mane; right card shows a green-shelled turtle with soft white glowing sparkles around it. The rest of each card is clean empty cream space with faint blank rows for text. In the upper right of the village area sits one small greyed-out button with a padlock icon. A thin blank cream status strip runs along the very top with one small gold coin icon near its right end.
Style/medium: crisp visible square pixels, refined 16-bit pixel art, consistent sprite scale, thick functional pixel UI borders, bright friendly palette. No antialiased painterly texture.
Lighting/mood: warm, playful, welcoming. Nothing scary.
Text (verbatim): none. Do not draw any letters, words, numbers or writing-like marks anywhere. Every card, bubble, button and bar is left blank so text can be added later.
Constraints: exactly three cards; no card hand or deck fanning; no combat; no blood or horror; no title, logo or watermark; all UI fully inside the frame.

title: 강 동네 지도
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: gameplay concept screenshot for a 2D pixel-art game planning article; opaque landscape 16:9, 1536x864.
Primary request: Show the branching route map of one area in a bright, cheerful turn-based roguelike set in a Korean folklore world. The area is a riverside.
Scene/backdrop: the left two thirds of the screen is a hand-drawn map on warm hanji paper. A light blue river winds from the bottom edge to the top. Tiny pine trees and soft hill doodles are scattered on the paper.
Subject: a branching path of round node plates rising from bottom to top in seven rows: 1, 3, 2, 3, 2, 3 nodes, then one large boss node at the top. Nodes are joined by thin dotted lines, each node linking to one or two nodes in the next row. Node pictograms: a brown paw print (ordinary yokai), a red horned little face (strong yokai), a tiny house with a glowing window (rest), a gold coin pouch (shop), a purple sparkle swirl (event), a small wooden chest (treasure). The boss node is larger with a red rim and holds a golden-orange fish with two tiny horns. The path already walked, from the bottom start node up two rows on the right side, is a solid orange line, and those passed nodes are faded grey. The current node has a golden ring and a small orange-and-white cat face token sits right beside it. A blue dotted arc jumps from the current node over the next row to a treasure node, showing a skip ability.
Composition/framing: the right third is a wooden-framed side panel with three stacked blank cream boxes. Top box: a portrait of the boss, a golden-orange fish leaping in an arc with red dorsal spikes, tiny yellow horns, long whiskers and a red forked tail. Middle box: blank except a small blue horse icon. Bottom box: a legend of the six node pictograms in two columns and three rows, each next to a blank line. A thin blank cream status strip runs along the very top with one small gold coin icon near its right end.
Style/medium: crisp visible square pixels, refined 16-bit pixel art, clean readable map icons, thick functional pixel UI borders, bright friendly palette. No antialiased painterly texture.
Lighting/mood: sunny, calm, adventurous. Nothing scary.
Text (verbatim): none. Do not draw any letters, words, numbers, question marks or writing-like marks anywhere. All boxes and lines are left blank so text can be added later.
Constraints: no characters walking on the map other than the cat face token; no combat; no cards; no title, logo or watermark; all UI fully inside the frame.

title: 강 우두머리와의 전투
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: gameplay concept screenshot for a 2D pixel-art game planning article; opaque landscape 16:9, 1536x864.
Primary request: Show a turn-based battle in a bright, cheerful roguelike set in a Korean folklore world. A small cat yokai faces the river leader, a fish that dreams of becoming a dragon. It is a playful contest, not a deadly fight.
Scene/backdrop: sunny riverside in daytime: a sandy bank with grass on the left, a pond on the right fed by a tall waterfall over grey rocks, green hills, pine trees and reeds. A grey rain cloud is gathering above the pond with a few light raindrops, showing the fish is charging a big water attack.
Subject: on the left bank sits Nabi, a small cat yokai: white fur with orange patches on the head, ears and back, pink inner ears, big dark eyes and a black pixel outline, with exactly three short fluffy orange-and-white tails fanned out behind. On the right a large golden-orange fish leaps out of the pond in a big arc, head facing the cat, with two small yellow horns, long whiskers, red dorsal spikes, a red forked tail and a determined but cute expression.
Composition/framing: classic side-view turn-based battle layout. Top left: a dark name plate with an empty green health bar about 70 percent full. Top right: a dark name plate with a red health bar about 75 percent full. Under the cat's plate: one small blank status chip with a tiny snail icon. Above the fish's head: a small blank intent bubble containing only a rain-cloud pictogram. Near the fish's mouth: an empty white speech bubble. The bottom quarter is a cream panel with exactly four skill buttons in one row: the first has a red top stripe; the second has a blue top stripe and a glowing golden selection border; the third is greyed out with a round dark badge in its corner showing it is cooling down; the fourth has a dashed outline and a padlock icon showing it is locked. A thin blank cream status strip runs along the very top with one small gold coin icon near its right end.
Style/medium: crisp visible square pixels, refined 16-bit pixel art, consistent sprite scale, thick functional pixel UI borders, bright friendly palette. No antialiased painterly texture.
Lighting/mood: clear daylight, lively and fun. Nothing scary.
Text (verbatim): none. Do not draw any letters, words, numbers or writing-like marks anywhere, including on buttons, bars and badges. Everything is left blank so text can be added later.
Constraints: exactly one cat and one fish; exactly four skill buttons; no cards; no blood, injury or horror; no title, logo or watermark; all UI fully inside the frame.
